rules.name: Clarity
rules.generation: Use unambiguous labels, recognizable controls, plain-language instructions, and a visible primary task.
rules.audit: Check calls to action, icons, headings, affordances, state, and consequences; do not infer accessible names from pixels.

rules.name: Consistency
rules.generation: Reuse owner tokens, components, terminology, navigation placement, and state behavior.
rules.audit: Group repeated one-off styling, labels, placement, or behavior under their systemic root cause.

rules.name: Simplicity
rules.generation: Keep elements that support comprehension, completion, confidence, or brand intent; disclose advanced detail progressively.
rules.audit: Check redundant controls, avoidable steps, repeated explanation, and decorative competition without penalizing required domain complexity.

rules.name: Visual hierarchy
rules.generation: Create a deliberate reading and action order through scale, weight, contrast, position, grouping, and whitespace.
rules.audit: Compare focal priority, heading order, action emphasis, and visual order against semantic and focus order.

rules.name: Scannability
rules.generation: Chunk content with meaningful headings, concise labels, stable alignment, and task-appropriate line length and density.
rules.audit: Check walls of text, weak anchors, long forms, comparison alignment, and key-information discovery.

rules.name: Color contrast
rules.generation: Meet applicable contrast requirements in every state, mode, overlay, and composite background using computed owner values.
rules.audit: Use measurements for ratios; visual evidence can identify risk but cannot prove exact composited contrast.

rules.name: Intentional color
rules.generation: Assign color through semantic roles, use high chroma sparingly, and provide a non-color cue for every meaning.
rules.audit: Check semantic conflicts, color-only state, competing accents, and separation of brand from severity meaning.

rules.name: Negative space
rules.generation: Use whitespace to reveal grouping, hierarchy, focus, and rhythm at the intended product density.
rules.audit: Check control crowding, edge collisions, uneven rhythm, disconnected empty regions, and space masking weak hierarchy.

rules.name: Typography hierarchy
rules.generation: Use a small tokenized type scale, clear role mapping, readable metrics, verified fonts, and robust scaling.
rules.audit: Check arbitrary styles, essential text size, line height, unavailable weights or glyphs, clipping, and semantic heading alignment.

rules.name: Immediate feedback
rules.generation: Define relevant pressed, selected, hover, focus, loading, success, error, empty, and disabled behavior.
rules.audit: Check silent actions, unstable progress, duplicate submission, and state feedback; static images cannot pass behavior criteria alone.

rules.name: User control
rules.generation: Provide exit, cancel, undo, pause, retry, and reversible paths proportional to risk while preserving user work.
rules.audit: Check traps, unnecessary irreversibility, destructive action safety, and dismissals that lose data or context.

rules.name: Error prevention and recovery
rules.generation: Prevent predictable errors, validate at useful times, identify the problem and remedy, and preserve valid input.
rules.audit: Check constraints, defaults, timing, error association, human-readable recovery, retry, and data preservation.

rules.name: Familiar patterns
rules.generation: Use platform and domain conventions unless a different pattern is demonstrably more suitable and learnable.
rules.audit: Check surprising navigation, placement, or control behavior and familiar-looking elements that behave unexpectedly.

rules.name: Choice limitation
rules.generation: Prioritize choices, provide defaults, group options, and progressively reveal advanced decisions.
rules.audit: Check equal-priority action clusters, ungrouped menus, deferrable decisions, and large sets without discovery support.

rules.name: Target sizing
rules.generation: Size and space complete interactive bounds for the actual touch, pointer, keyboard, and assistive input profile.
rules.audit: Measure bounds rather than glyphs and consider platform baselines, exceptions, edge placement, reach, frequency, and consequence.

rules.name: Proximity and grouping
rules.generation: Place labels, help, errors, actions, and content near the items they describe and expose groups without color alone.
rules.audit: Check detached labels or errors, misassociated actions, ambiguous containers, and grouping based only on color.

rules.name: Accessibility
rules.generation: Support semantics, names, keyboard and focus, alternatives, reflow, scaling, orientation, reduced motion, localization, and assistive updates.
rules.audit: Use appropriate runtime, source, and accessibility evidence; score contrast under R06 and target size under R15 without duplicate deductions.
